Son Arrested for Murder of Pharmaceutical Businessman Father in Kanpur

Police in Kanpur have arrested Subrat, the son of pharmaceutical businessman Vineet Minocha, in connection with his father's murder. Initial reports suggested the daughter-in-law might be involved, but investigations have now focused on Subrat. Coverage indicates Subrat was under financial pressure and allegedly conspired to kill his father, hiring shooters. Some reports mention a confrontation between Subrat and an individual named Shalu during the investigation. Subrat reportedly stated he wanted his father dead but regretted the stabbing.
